study_identification_part.si_4_title: Extreme deviations from the normative model reveal cortical heterogeneity and associations with negative symptom severity in first-episode psychosis from the OPTiMiSE and GAP studies

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: GAP (including ATLAS subset), OPTiMiSE, and a large multi-site reference normative model (N=37,126) used as a pre-trained base.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We included data from two large samples... GAP... and... OPTiMiSE... As there were fewer control participants in the older age range in the GAP sample, additional data (n = 124) from control participants in the ATLAS study were used to supplement the sample... We used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model... built from healthy participant data (n = 37,126)...
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Worker2023.pdf.md: METHODS / Participants & Normative modelling and statistical analysis

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The reference model was pre-trained. GAP (specifically ATLAS subset) and OPTiMiSE (50% controls) were used for model adaptation (site effects). The remaining GAP and OPTiMiSE data were used for testing (deviations estimation).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: parameters of this reference normative model were adapted to the new sites with 50% of control participant data from each clinical site from the OPTiMiSE sample... ATLAS data was selected as the adaptation set... For both samples, the remaining control participant and patient data were used as test samples...
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Worker2023.pdf.md: METHODS / Normative modelling and statistical analysis

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Base model N=37,126. Adaptation set N=199 (124 ATLAS + ~75 OPTiMiSE). Test set N=149. Train phase = Base + Adaptation. Overall = Train + Test.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: We used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model... (n = 37,126)... 199 control participant brain scans were used for adaptation... resulting in a test sample consisting of... 149 control participants
